description: tether/claude_code/settings.py enumerates tether/cli.py command surface for Claude Code. ALLOW_SUBCOMMANDS lists the agent-facing subcommands pre-approved as permissions (status/refresh/update/add/mv/refs/show/coverage, deliberately excluding rm and init), and HOOK_EVENTS maps the three hook subcommand names (session-start/stop/pre-tool-use) plus their matchers. Adding a new agent-facing subcommand in cli.py requires adding it to ALLOW_SUBCOMMANDS or the agent cannot invoke it; renaming any allowed or hook subcommand must be mirrored in settings.py or the permission/hook silently breaks.
